claims.evidence: Origin is not shown in Photo 0; no documents, branding, or identifying marks indicate country of origin.
Photo 0 shows dust and grime on the engine block and nearby parts.
The report states whether the engine runs or starts is not shown.
No warranty document or guarantee terms appear in the report.

risks.risk: Engine does not run or start
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine starting and running under its own power.
Odometer reading, service records, or donor vehicle documents.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age and high mileage

risks.proof: Import documents, engine number, or VIN matching a known vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced without any import or origin premium

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as alternator, starter, or ECU
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories or an itemized list with photos.

risks.risk: No compression or leak-down test results
risks.proof: Test report or video of a compression or leak-down test.
Borescope inspection video or teardown photos showing cylinders and internals.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Photos of any included accessories such as alternator, starter, or ECU
Documents showing origin or donor vehicle
Service records or compression test results
response.reason: The witness identifies a used car engine, so it can be priced at its worst case; unproven claims and hidden risks lower the value until proof is provided.
